source_campaign: T001 Котки v4: HERO тъмносин фон от нулата

banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely. The background must fill the WHOLE frame edge to edge (no bars, no borders, no frames, no inner frame).
LAYOUT (critical - the final banner is cut to 4:5 from the centre of this tall frame, so the top 15% and the bottom 15% are thrown away): the top 19% of the frame contains ONLY plain background. The headline starts at about 21% from the top. The bottom of the CTA button is at about 78% from the top. Everything below 80% is ONLY plain background. Keep about 7% side margins.
EXACT VERTICAL LAYOUT (percent of the full frame height, from the top): 0-20% only background. 21-34% the headline (three lines). 35-64% the three badges and the book. 65-72% the subheadline (two lines). 73-78% the CTA button. 79-100% only background.
FORMAT: HERO - the book cover is the hero (IMAGE 3 is a winning HERO banner of ours - copy its clean structure only, NOT its colours or texts).
BACKGROUND: rich DEEP NAVY BLUE #0F1F3D with a soft radial glow behind the book and a few faint lighter-navy paw prints, so the light-blue book cover POPS out with strong contrast. A soft warm glow behind the book.
SCENE: on the left a vertical column of three BIG round photo badges with a white ring (each about 30% of the banner width) and a small red cross in the corner of each: (1) close-up of a light fabric sofa armrest shredded by cat claws, (2) a grey tabby cat playfully holding a person's hand with its paws and gently nibbling a finger - completely clean skin, NO scratches, NO marks, NO red lines, (3) a cat litter box with litter scattered on the floor next to it. A bold curved yellow #F5C518 arrow goes from the badges to the book. On the right the book (IMAGE 2) as a large 3D paperback, slightly turned, about 38% of the banner width.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline, heavy condensed, three lines: line 1 "Котката ти" in white; line 2 "драска, хапе или" and line 3 "пропуска тоалетната?" in near-black on a bright yellow #F5C518 highlighter stripe.
2) Subheadline under the badges and the book, white, bold, big, two lines: "Системата P.U.R.R. променя лошите навици с награди, а не наказания."
3) CTA button: "Виж как 👉"
IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "Щастлива котка, щастлив стопанин" (it shows a 3D paperback mockup on white - use only the book itself, not the white background). Reproduce it exactly on the physical book: same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation, quotation marks and capital letters. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic).
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline at least ~4.8% of the banner height (bold, very easy to read on a phone), CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white text on the dark background; accent words on a yellow #F5C518 highlighter stripe in near-black; no grey text.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white text, centred near the bottom of the central area. The pointing-hand emoji at the end of the CTA is drawn as a small yellow pointing-right hand icon.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, percentages or website addresses anywhere. No phone screens, no chat or messenger interface, no notification badges.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin and fur texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each. The cat looks natural and healthy, no injuries, no blood.

CRITICAL POSITION CHECK: the FIRST line of any text must start no higher than 17% of the frame height from the top. The CTA button must end no lower than 87% of the frame height.
NO extra text anywhere in the scene: no posters, signs, wall lettering or written papers besides the book cover.
